manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp439-445 describes Control.APID selection across StockAllocation, ResourceAllocation and MaintenanceAllocation. Manual pp338-339 describes task-referenced ItemRepair category/level/station matching. Accepted C01-derived resource donor establishes P-CREW preparation demand, and accepted I01.var03 parent establishes stock and maintenance effects separately.
controlled_design: The four inputs differ from each other only in Control.APID and ProblemDescription. All have the accepted parent stock sizes BASE1/DEPOT0 under AIR_BASIC/AIR_DEPOT, BASE2/DEPOT0 under AIR_TWO_BASE/AIR_TWO_DEPOT, with matching maintenance assignment BASE/DEPOT crossed. Each POINT additionally allocates P-CREW2 when the BASE stock level is1 or P-CREW3 when stock level is2, plus P-OTHER0. A donor-copied BASIC-MISSION preparation uses PREP-FIXED, two 10/20-minute subtasks and P-CREW2 in the first subtask, so either selected resource capacity can execute the same active preparation. Failed-LRU ItemRepair task, station/transport, missions, seed and horizon otherwise remain fixed. No ItemReorder business rows.

pre_run_hypotheses.resource: Selected P-CREW total capacity should appear as 2 or3 in ResourceResults and active two-crew preparation should complete before the first mission in all arms. The extra crew is surplus; no resource shortage is expected. This is not independent resource-vs-stock factorial isolation because the two capacities track the two stock sizes.
pre_run_hypotheses.stock_and_maintenance: The accepted parent physical BASE stock size1/2 and BASE/DEPOT failed-item repair crossover should remain observable when preparation resources are added. Physical item IDs, failure draw, repair timings, mission outcomes, and aggregate reports are conditional until native observations are checked.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, preparation failing to activate, any selected resource capacity not observable, stock/repair route divergence, missing report or incomplete physical accounting is diagnostic. Preserve contrary outcomes; do not publish a positive three-allocation claim without complete matched native evidence and independent replay.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run audit of parent and donor lineage, four frozen sources, exact APID-only delta, roundtrip checker and guarded native runner
Four serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, valid SXO/report and sealed raw artifacts in each arm
Physical resource lease/preparation, initial/issued/returned stock, selected failed-item repair station, full Resource/System/Stock report bins and terminal state reconciled
Author validation, independent read-only replay and final staged audit before any bounded publication
limits: A positive result would show simultaneous selection of these three complete allocation tables for one LRU, one preparation task, four POINTs and one seed. Resource capacity 2/3 is correlated with stock size1/2; their separate causal effects are not isolated here.
No resource shortage, procurement, reorder, other task categories or levels, generic POINT selection, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity is claimed.
